covers: Run from a project whose local scope defines onlylocal and a second copy of shadow, list and get show those copies. agent-sync runs claude in an empty directory and sees user scope: onlylocal is added there, and the user-scope shadow, which drifted, is re-added. corp, which get shows at enterprise scope, is left uncompared and named in a note.
deviation: The script ran claude in the caller's directory, so it compared the local copies with the desired user-scope specs. plan showed onlylocal and shadow as ~ on every run, and the drifted user-scope shadow was never compared. sync failed with exit 2 removing onlylocal at user scope, where it does not exist.
